articles.summary: Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL) announced today that it will report financial results for its third quarter of 2026 on Wednesday, October 21 after the market close. The company will host a webcast and conference call to discuss highlights of its financial results on Thursday, October 22 at 9:30 a.m. ET. The call will be hosted by Chairman, CEO and President Tom Gentile and Chief Financial Officer Jamie Coogan. The event will be webcast via the Investor Relations webpage at www.Hexcel.com . The event can also be accessed by dialing +1 (585)-542-9983. The conference ID is 512 023 355. A replay of the call will be available on the investor relations page of the Hexcel website approximately two hours after the conclusion of the call.
